page_title: COM 1-1 GEN | Como v Genoa 15/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van der Brempt I. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Cesc Fabregas isn't happy on the touchline after referee Marco Piccinini shows him a yellow card.

90+4' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Jean Butez shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+4' Aaron Martin (Genoa) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+2' 1 - 1 Goal! Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
90+2' A great pass puts Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.
90+1' It’s taken a long time, but here comes the VAR review into that red card for Jacobo Ramon (Como): it’s upheld, he has to go!
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

89' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Jacobo Ramon (Como), but referee Marco Piccinini must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
88' Jacobo Ramon (Como) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
86' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
86' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
85' The substitution has been made. Martin Baturina (Como) has replaced Jesus Rodriguez.
84' Nicola Leali (Genoa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
83' Nicola Leali (Genoa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Genoa.
82' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
81' Sergi Roberto (Como) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
81' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lorenzo Colombo.
79' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' Ooh that was close! Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
78' Genoa are seeing far more of the ball now.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jayden Addai (Como) for Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn.
73' That will be all from Maxence Caqueret who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sergi Roberto (Como).
71' Substitution. Ruslan Malinovskyi did his best and is replaced by Valentin Carboni (Genoa).
71' Patrick Vieira has decided to make a change. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) replaces Mikael Egill Ellertsson.
70' Alex Valle (Como) makes a slide tackle, but referee Marco Piccinini blows for a foul.

67' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Nicola Leali, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maximo Perrone (Como) comes onto the pitch for Lucas Da Cunha.
65' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Alvaro Morata is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Como).
63' That was close by Maxence Caqueret (Como)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
59' Patrick Vieira (Genoa) gets a yellow card, off the field.
57' Substitution. Stefano Sabelli makes his way off the pitch and Junior Messias (Genoa) comes on as his replacement.
54' A cross by Patrizio Masini (Genoa) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
52' A snap shot from distance by Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
50' Alvaro Morata (Como) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
48' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
47' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Jean Butez has no trouble gathering it.
46' Aaron Martin (Genoa) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+1' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the corner but it's cleared.
41' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Nicola Leali is alert and makes a decent save.
39' Alex Valle (Como) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
38' Nico Paz (Como) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
36' Alvaro Morata (Como) gets a nice pass from Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn on the edge of the box, he looks up and tries to beat the keeper in the corner but it goes just wide of the right post.
34' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
33' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!

30' Nice individual effort by Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom left corner, but Nicola Leali does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
29' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
28' One of the Como players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
24' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
21' Jacobo Ramon (Como) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
18' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
17' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) is able to continue to play.
16' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) picks up an injury.
13' 1 - 0 Nico Paz (Como) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the right post.
12' Nico Paz (Como) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
11' Nico Paz (Como) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
10' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
10' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Referee Marco Piccinini sees the trip by Patrizio Masini (Genoa) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
2' The ball is behind the sideline. Mergim Vojvoda (Como) takes a throw-in.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Como will take the kick-off.
Marco Piccinini will supervise the game today.
